subject: math
title: Line Symmetry
seo_title: Grade 4 Line Symmetry Worksheets: Lines of Symmetry in Shapes, Letters and Pictures
standard_text: Recognize a line of symmetry for a two-dimensional figure as a line across the figure such that the figure can be folded along the line into matching parts. Identify line-symmetric figures and draw lines of symmetry.
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 line symmetry worksheets with pictures: test a dashed line with the fold test, count the lines of symmetry of squares, rectangles, triangles and regular polygons, find symmetric capital letters, complete symmetric pictures on a grid, and solve word problems. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_big: A line of symmetry folds a figure into two halves that match exactly.
key_sub: A square has 4 lines, a rectangle only 2: its diagonals cut it in half, but folded on a diagonal the corners stick out. Letters like N, S and Z look the same upside down but have no line of symmetry.
body_html:
The fold test

A line of symmetry is a line across a figure so that, if you fold the figure on the line, the two halves match exactly. Each half is the mirror image of the other.

A figure can have many lines, or none

Try every way to fold. A line of symmetry can go up and down, across or slanted.

FigureLines of symmetry
Square4
Rectangle (not a square)2
Rhombus (not a square)2 (corner to corner)
Triangle with 3 equal sides3
Triangle with 2 equal sides1
Triangle with 3 different sides0
Kite1
Trapezoid with 2 equal slanted sides1
Parallelogram (slanted)0
Regular pentagon, hexagon, octagon5, 6, 8 (one for each side)
CircleInfinitely many

Letters

Capital letters can have a vertical line, a horizontal line, both, or none.

Complete a picture

To finish a symmetric picture, give every square a partner the same distance from the line on the other side. Flip it like a mirror; do not slide it.

Example

How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have?

3 lines go corner to corner. 3 more go through the middles of opposite sides. 3 + 3 = 6.

Answer: 6

Example

Does the letter Z have a line of symmetry?

Fold up and down: the top line goes right but the bottom goes left. Fold across: the slant does not match. Z looks the same after a half turn, but a turn is not a fold.

Answer: No, 0 lines

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting a rectangle’s diagonals (4 lines)Fold on a diagonal: the corners stick out. A rectangle has 2
Forgetting a square’s diagonals (2 lines)A square folds on its diagonals too: 4 lines
Thinking only up-and-down lines countLines can go across or slant. Try every way to fold
Saying N, S or Z have a line because they look the same upside downThat is a turn, not a fold. They have 0 lines
Sliding the half when completing a pictureFlip it: each square goes the same distance on the other side

faq.q: What is a line of symmetry in 4th grade math?
faq.a: A line of symmetry is a line across a figure so that the figure can be folded on it into two matching halves. A heart has 1 line of symmetry, straight down the middle.

faq.q: Does a rectangle have 4 lines of symmetry?
faq.a: No. A rectangle that is not a square has 2 lines of symmetry: up and down and across. Its diagonals cut it in half, but the halves do not match when folded.

faq.q: Which capital letters have a line of symmetry?
faq.a: A, M, T, U, V, W and Y have a vertical line; B, C, D and E have a horizontal line; H, I, O and X have both. F, G, J, L, N, P, Q, R, S and Z have none (in simple block letters).

faq.q: How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
faq.a: Infinitely many. Every line through the center of a circle folds it into two matching halves.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
items.e: A square has 4 lines of symmetry: 1 up and down, 1 across, and 2 along the diagonals, corner to corner. Do not forget the diagonals.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle have?
items.e: A rectangle has 2 lines of symmetry: up and down and across, through the middles of the sides. The diagonals cut it in half, but folded on a diagonal the corners stick out.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a triangle with 3 equal sides have?
items.e: Each line goes from a corner to the middle of the opposite side. There are 3 corners, so there are 3 lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a triangle with 2 equal sides have?
items.e: Only the line from the top corner down to the middle of the bottom side works, so there is 1 line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a triangle with 3 different sides have?
items.e: All 3 sides have different lengths, so no fold makes the halves match. There are 0 lines of symmetry.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
items.e: Every line through the center of a circle folds it into matching halves. There are infinitely many lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rhombus have?
items.e: A rhombus that is not a square has 2 lines of symmetry, and both go corner to corner (its diagonals). Lines through the middles of the sides do not work.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a parallelogram have?
items.e: A slanted parallelogram has 0 lines of symmetry. Its diagonals cut it in half, but folded the corners stick out.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a kite have?
items.e: Only the long line from the top corner to the bottom corner works, so a kite has 1 line of symmetry.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a trapezoid with 2 equal slanted sides have?
items.e: Only the up-and-down line through the middles of the top and bottom works. A line across does not, because the top is shorter than the bottom. 1 line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle that is turned have?
items.e: Turning a shape does not change its lines of symmetry. It is still a rectangle, so it has 2 lines. They are slanted now, along with the rectangle.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a pentagon with 5 equal sides and 5 equal angles have?
items.e: Each line goes from a corner to the middle of the opposite side. 5 corners, so 5 lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a hexagon with 6 equal sides and 6 equal angles have?
items.e: 3 lines go corner to corner and 3 more go through the middles of opposite sides: 3 + 3 = 6 lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this plus sign (all 4 arms the same) have?
items.e: Up and down and across work, and so do the 2 slanted lines corner to corner: 4 lines, like a square.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does an octagon with 8 equal sides and 8 equal angles have?
items.e: 4 lines go corner to corner and 4 go through the middles of opposite sides: 4 + 4 = 8 lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this L shape (both arms the same size) have?
items.e: Up and down and across do not work. But the slanted line from the inside corner to the outside corner folds one arm onto the other: 1 line.

items.q: Which shape has exactly 2 lines of symmetry?
items.e: Count the lines for each shape: A (rectangle) 2 lines, B (triangle with 2 equal sides) 1 line, C (parallelogram) 0 lines, D (square) 4 lines. The answer is A.

items.q: Which shape has no lines of symmetry?
items.e: Count the lines for each shape: A (right triangle with 2 equal sides) 1 line, B (triangle with 2 equal sides) 1 line, C (triangle with 3 different sides) 0 lines, D (triangle with 3 equal sides) 3 lines. The answer is C.

items.q: Which shape has the most lines of symmetry?
items.e: Count the lines for each shape: A (pentagon) 5 lines, B (square) 4 lines, C (triangle with 3 equal sides) 3 lines, D (hexagon) 6 lines. The answer is D.

items.q: Which shape has exactly 1 line of symmetry?
items.e: Count the lines for each shape: A (rectangle) 2 lines, B (trapezoid) 1 line, C (rhombus) 2 lines, D (parallelogram) 0 lines. The answer is B.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the letter A have: vertical (up and down), horizontal (across), both, or none?
items.e: A fold straight down the middle matches the two slanted sides. A fold across does not: the top is a point and the bottom is open.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the letter B have: vertical (up and down), horizontal (across), both, or none?
items.e: Fold B across the middle: the top bump lands on the bottom bump. Folded up and down, the bumps on the right have nothing to match on the left.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the letter H have: vertical (up and down), horizontal (across), both, or none?
items.e: H folds into matching halves straight down the middle and across the middle, so it has both.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the letter R have: vertical (up and down), horizontal (across), both, or none?
items.e: Folded up and down, the bump and the leg are on one side only. Folded across, the bump does not match the leg. R has no line of symmetry.
Fold C across the middle: the top half lands on the bottom half. Up and down does not work, because C is open on the right only.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the letter M have: vertical (up and down), horizontal (across), both, or none?
items.e: A fold straight down the middle matches the two halves of M. Folded across, the top and bottom do not match.
This O is taller than it is wide. It folds into matching halves up and down and across: both. (It is not a circle, so the slanted folds do not work.)

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the letter N have: vertical (up and down), horizontal (across), both, or none?
items.e: No fold makes N match. N looks the same after a half turn, but turning is not folding, so N has no line of symmetry.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the letter E have: vertical (up and down), horizontal (across), both, or none?
items.e: Fold E across the middle: the top arm lands on the bottom arm. Up and down does not work, because all the arms point right.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the letter U have: vertical (up and down), horizontal (across), both, or none?
items.e: A fold straight down the middle matches the two sides of U. Folded across, the round bottom does not match the open top.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the letter X have: vertical (up and down), horizontal (across), both, or none?
items.e: This X is taller than it is wide. It matches when folded up and down and when folded across: both.
No fold makes S match. S looks the same after a half turn, but a turn is not a fold, so S has no line of symmetry.

items.q: Which letter has a line of symmetry?
items.e: T has a vertical line of symmetry. F, L and J have none.
D has a horizontal line of symmetry. G, P and R have none.

items.q: Which letter has no line of symmetry?
items.e: Z has none: it looks the same after a half turn, but no fold matches. T (vertical), H (both) and E (horizontal) each have at least one.
G has none: the bar inside G breaks the match across. C (horizontal), U and W (vertical) each have one.

items.q: Which letter has a horizontal line of symmetry?
items.e: Fold D across the middle and the halves match. A, V and Y have a vertical line, not a horizontal one.
Fold W straight down the middle and the halves match. B, E and C have a horizontal line, not a vertical one.

items.q: Which letter has 2 lines of symmetry?
items.e: I matches when folded up and down and when folded across: 2 lines. T and Y have only a vertical line, and E only a horizontal line.

items.q: Which letter has no line of symmetry?
items.e: H, I and X have 2 lines each. N looks the same after a half turn, like H, I and X, but no fold matches, so N has none.

items.q: The dashed line goes through the middle of a column. Shade squares on the right so the dashed line is a line of symmetry. How many squares will be shaded in all?
items.e: 10 squares are shaded now. 3 of them are on the line, so they are their own partners: count them once. The other 7 get a partner each. 7 + 7 + 3 = 17.

items.q: The dashed line goes through the middle of a column. How many more squares must you shade so the dashed line is a line of symmetry?
items.e: Only squares that are not on the line need a partner. 9 squares are shaded and 3 are on the line, so 9 - 3 = 6 more squares.

items.q: The dashed line goes through the middle of a row. Shade squares on the bottom so the dashed line is a line of symmetry. How many squares will be shaded in all?
items.e: 12 squares are shaded now. 5 of them are on the line, so they are their own partners: count them once. The other 7 get a partner each. 7 + 7 + 5 = 19.

items.q: The dashed line goes through the middle of a column. How many more squares must you shade so the dashed line is a line of symmetry?

Only the line straight down the body works: each wing lands on the wing on the other side. Folded across, the big top wings would not match the small bottom wings. 1 line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this leaf have?
items.e: The line down the middle vein works: the veins on each side match. Folded across, the stem has nothing to match, so there is only 1 line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this flag have?
items.e: The top and bottom stripes are the same color, so folding across works, and folding up and down works too: 2 lines. The diagonals do not work, just like in a rectangle.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this flag have?
items.e: Folding across puts blue on green, so that does not work. Folding up and down matches blue to blue and green to green: 1 line. Colors must match too.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this flag have?
items.e: The cross is to the left of the middle, so folding up and down does not work. Folding across does: 1 line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this flag have?
items.e: Folding on the band itself does not work, because the flag is not a square: the corners stick out. Up and down and across do not work either. 0 lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a sign with this shape (no words on it) have?
items.e: The sign is a regular octagon: 4 lines go corner to corner and 4 go through the middles of opposite sides. 8 lines. (With the word STOP written on it, it would have none.)

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this sign have?
items.e: The sign is a triangle with 3 equal sides. Each line goes from a corner to the middle of the opposite side: 3 lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this sign have?
items.e: The sign is a square turned on its corner, and turning does not change symmetry. 2 lines go corner to corner and 2 go through the middles of the sides: 4 lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this pinwheel have?
items.e: The pinwheel looks the same after a quarter turn, but every blade leans the same way, so no fold matches. Turning is not folding: 0 lines.

items.q: Ava has a square sheet of paper. In how many different ways can she fold it in half so that the two halves match exactly?
items.e: A square has 4 lines of symmetry: up and down, across, and the 2 diagonals. So there are 4 ways.

items.q: Leo folds a rectangular rug that is 6 feet long and 4 feet wide along its diagonal, from corner to corner. Do the two halves match?
c: Yes, every line through the middle works
Yes, both halves are the same size
No, a rug has no line of symmetry
items.e: The diagonal cuts the rug into 2 triangles of the same size, but they do not land on each other when folded, because the rug is not a square. A rectangle has only 2 lines of symmetry.

items.q: Noah says every line through the middle of a rectangle is a line of symmetry. Is he right?
items.e: Only the line up and down and the line across fold a rectangle into matching halves. Slanted lines and diagonals do not.

items.q: Mia writes these words in capital letters. Which word has a horizontal line of symmetry?
items.e: B, O and X each have a horizontal line of symmetry through their middles, so the whole word BOX does too. MOM and TOT have a vertical line through the middle letter, not a horizontal one. S has no line at all.

items.q: Which word has a vertical line of symmetry through its middle letter?
items.e: W and O each have a vertical line of symmetry, so a vertical line through the O folds the first W onto the last W. In BOB and DAD the B and D face right, so their mirror images would be backward. Z has no line of symmetry.

items.q: A shape has exactly 1 line of symmetry. Which shape could it be?
c: A trapezoid with 2 equal slanted sides
items.e: A trapezoid with 2 equal slanted sides has only the up-and-down line. A rectangle has 2, a square has 4 and a slanted parallelogram has 0.

items.q: Kai draws a shape with 4 equal sides. It has exactly 2 lines of symmetry, and both go from corner to corner. What shape is it?
c: A rhombus that is not a square
items.e: A rhombus has 2 lines of symmetry along its diagonals. A square would have 4, a rectangle’s 2 lines go through the middles of the sides, and a kite has 1.

items.q: Lily folds a sheet of paper in half, cuts out a shape along the fold, and opens it. What must be true?
c: The shape has exactly 2 lines of symmetry
One half is bigger than the other
The fold is a line of symmetry
The shape has no line of symmetry
items.e: Both halves were cut at the same time, so they are mirror images. The fold line is always a line of symmetry. The shape could have other lines too, but it does not have to.

items.q: Ben says the letter S has a line of symmetry because it looks the same upside down. Is he right?
c: No, a turn is not a fold
Yes, it has a horizontal line
Yes, it looks the same upside down
items.e: S looks the same after a half turn, but no fold makes the two halves match. A line of symmetry is about folding, so S has 0 lines.

items.q: Zoe cuts out a circle. How many different lines can she fold it on so that the two halves match?
items.e: Every line through the center of a circle is a line of symmetry, so there are infinitely many. Up and down, across and the 2 diagonals are just 4 of them.
